{{Top|leg}}
A '''proton grenade launcher''' was a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] designed to deploy [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenades]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Some variants of [[Spacetrooper armor/Legends|spacetrooper armor]] had inbuilt proton grenade launchers.

Twin proton grenade launchers were equipped on [[All Terrain Experimental Transport|AT-XT walkers]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
